counters.why: Mister Sinister is repeatedly cited as a Bullseye option; his sustain helps absorb unavoidable chip while Concussion can reduce other defensive pressure.
counters.strategy: Play for clean Special Attack baiting rather than racing Bullseye, use Sinister's sustain to stabilize the unavoidable damage, and build Concussion when the opening is safe.
counters.risks: This is not an Evade shutdown. Bullseye can still punish uncontrolled combos, and Sinister can be slower than dedicated current-meta answers.
conditions: Do not treat Concussion as a guaranteed answer to Bullseye's protected Evade.
Prioritize survival and clean openings over speed.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions repeatedly cite Mister Sinister; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Spiral is repeatedly recommended into The Serpent; Falter immunity and Destroy give her tools for two of the matchup's most disruptive defensive effects.
counters.strategy: Ramp Spiral safely, use Destroy when Serpent's relevant Buffs are active, and keep enough control to answer Power Gain instead of committing to a blind burst.
counters.risks: Serpent's Death Immunity and node package can still extend the fight. Destroy does not mean every defensive Buff disappears at once.
conditions: Build the rotation before the Death Immunity window instead of relying on one final burst.
Check current nodes for effects that protect Buffs or punish Power control.
counters.scoreReason: Repeated community recommendations support Spiral into Serpent; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Luke Cage is a current community-reported Enchantress counter; Concussion and Debilitate give useful control once you are correctly clearing her spells.
counters.strategy: Use the required actions to remove Enchantress's active spells first, then apply Concussion and Debilitate during the clean damage window.
counters.risks: Luke Cage does not bypass Enchantress's spell-removal minigame. Ignoring the displayed spell requirements can still end the fight quickly.
conditions: Complete the spell-removal actions before treating the defender as a normal matchup.
Do not assume Concussion shuts down every protected or node-granted effect.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Luke Cage; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.
